threads.intro: This conversation knows only this note and what it links to. It ends by itself after 30 minutes without a question.

overview.text:
Your note on moving dibs off the laptop onto a small always-on box. It's researched, not bought. The pick is a used Lenovo M70q Gen 3 with 32 GB of memory, about 1,550 ₪.

- 16 GB is too little: builds alone use up to 13 GB.
- It runs on your Max plan: no extra monthly cost.
- About 10 W idle, roughly 35 ₪ a year in power.

Still open: used or new, and where it sits at home.
chips: Used or new: what's the risk with a used one?
What moves off the laptop first?

lines.text: Two Rust builds at once peak at about 13 GB, and every open agent adds about 0.2 GB. With 16 GB it would swap whenever a build runs, which makes everything slow.
**The Dell at 900 ₪** has 8 GB soldered to the board, so it can never reach 32 GB. That rules it out.
chips: How much does 32 GB cost on its own?
Can it build the phone apps too?

lines.text: ok add the price to the note
Passed to dibs as your words: “ok add the price to the note”. dibs does it and tells you in the main chat. This conversation only answers questions.
